title: India is kicking car safety into top gear with Bharat NCAP 2.0: What you need to know
description: Bharat NCAP is set to evolve with its second phase, Bharat NCAP 2.0, planned for October 2027. This revised framework will assess vehicle safety across multiple stages, including crash avoidance and post-collision care. The new system promises to go beyond just occupant protection to include vulnerable road users as well. Adult and child occupant protection will remain critical components of the evaluation process.

title: Michigan family lost $194,400 home over $2,242 tax bill; Supreme Court steps in
description: The United States Supreme Court has made a landmark decision stating that tax sale compensation must be based on the auction price rather than the assessed value of a property. A family in Michigan, burdened with a $2,241.93 tax debt, faced foreclosure despite their home being valued at $194,400. With the auction yielding only $76,008, the family is rightfully awarded the remaining $73,766.07, reinforcing constitutional guidelines for future tax sales.

title: Mumbai prime home prices rise 6.2%, enter global top 10
description: In a striking development, Mumbai has surged into the world’s top 10 residential markets, landing at eighth place with a notable 6.2% annual price gain. Bengaluru and New Delhi aren't far behind, securing the 12th and 17th spots. While global prices ticked up by only 2.6%, Mumbai's luxury segment stands resilient, fueled by high demand and limited housing options in prime locales.

title: Massive fire at Delhi building housing Haldiram’s outlet; 30 rescued
description: A fire broke out in a three-storey building in northwest Delhi's Model Town area. The incident occurred around 2pm, with thick smoke seen billowing from the building. After a swift police response, around 30 people were safely evacuated from the premises. The Delhi fire service deployed 23 units to control the medium fire, which started due to a suspected short circuit.

Baranica Elangovan made waves as she bagged a bronze medal in women's pole vault, a historic first for the nation. In shooting, Suruchi Singh and Kamaljeet delivered a sensational performance, earning gold and ending a lengthy wait for that accolade.

Led by Col Ranveer Singh Jamwal from the National Institute of Mountaineering and Adventure Sports, Dirang, their remarkable feat emphasizes India's strength in mountaineering and enhances its stature on the global stage.

title: Called ‘black-complexioned’ and ‘fatty-shaped’: Why man’s divorce plea failed
description: A husband in Chhattisgarh appealed for divorce from his wife due to claims of cruelty and desertion. The high court examined the evidence and found the husband's allegations lacked proof. The court noted that inappropriate comments alone did not justify granting a divorce. Additionally, the wife provided counterclaims against her husband’s behavior and care. Consequently, the court upheld the family court's decision and dismissed the divorce appeal.

Sam Praneeth Reddy from Vanasthalipuram won the prestigious laddu after competing against eight bidders. The tradition of auctioning the laddu began in 1994, with initial bids starting as low as Rs 450. The revenue generated is utilized for Ganesh Puja celebrations and community development programs.

He argues that continuing to contest gives legitimacy to flawed electoral processes. Dipke highlights that such participation undermines democracy and fears for political survival. His comments follow multiple instances where election commissioners objected to decisions of the Election Commission. Dipke even proposed a further agitation if his demands regarding election integrity are ignored.

title: Zuckerberg’s $300m superyacht docks in Japan, gets neighbour who once wanted Meta out
description: Mark Zuckerberg's impressive superyacht, Launchpad, has recently anchored in Japan, right beside Yusaku Maezawa's Nausicaä. Their close proximity underscores an ongoing legal dispute as Maezawa pursues Meta for the misuse of his name in deceptive investment advertising. Even without plans to meet, their vessels symbolize the intense rivalry. After a summer in Alaska, Launchpad is set to chart its course towards Singapore, making this encounter noteworthy.

title: ‘Gun nikal’: Delhi victim recounts how rapists took turns, held knife to her neck
description: A 17-year-old girl experienced a disturbing incident on her birthday inside Aastha Kunj Park. After visiting Kalkaji Mandir, she and her friend were approached by three men claiming to be police officers. The men allegedly assaulted the girl at knife point in various locations within the park. After the attacks, they threatened her and her friend to remain silent about the incident.
